title: Laila Small Leather Shoulder Bag
description_html:
Laila Small Leather Shoulder Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 12.75”W X 5.25”H X 4.5”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 8.5”
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Leather
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Zip fastening
